Points $P$ and $Q$ are shown in the picture above. Find $|\overset{\to }{PQ}|$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
From the picture, we obtain $P(8,-3)$ and $Q(-1,-1).$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned} & \overset{\to }{OP}=p=8i-3j, \\  & \overset{\to }{OQ}=q=-i-j.\end{aligned}
$$

Expressing $\overset{\to }{PQ}$ as the difference of position vectors, we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{PQ} & =\overset{\to }{OQ}-\overset{\to }{OP} \\  & =q-p \\  & =(-i-j)-(8i-3j) \\  & =-9i+2j\end{aligned}
$$

The displacement components are $(-1)-(8)=-9$ and $(-1)-(-3)=2$.

Now, using the formula for the magnitude of a vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|\overset{\to }{PQ}| & =\sqrt{(-9)^{2}+(2)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{81+4} \\  & =\sqrt{85}.\end{aligned}
$$
